guide:0:0:0.text: A team built from Identities that apply and maintain Bleed. Choose a Ring variant with 5 Ring members, or a Bloodfiend variant that cycles Bloodfeast through La Manchaland Identities.

guide:1:0:0.text: Ring Identities combine strong Bleed application with strong physical performance, making sustained Bleed practical.

guide:1:0:1.text: Many skills scale with the number of enemy negative effects, so stacking debuffs raises the whole team's damage.

guide:1:0:2.text: [The Ring Pointillist Student](persona:0109) is a near-priority pick in both Ring and Bloodfiend variants.

guide:2:0:0.text: **Ring**: With at least 5 Ring members, the Corporist [Ring Nursefather](persona:0614) and [Ring Apprentice](persona:0215) start with 10 Corpus Ingredient for a stronger opening. Best against single targets, though the Nursefather's area S3 also handles groups.

guide:2:0:1.text: **Bloodfiends**: [The Manager of La Manchaland](persona:0310) enhances S3 using Bloodfeast accumulated through other La Manchaland Identities and Bleed damage. [The One Who Grips](persona:0204)'s Whistles quickly raises SP. Play on the assumption that enemy Bleed will not build very high.

guide:3:0:0.text: In the Ring variant, stack at least 5 Mauled Color from [The Ring Fauvist Docent](persona:0915), then land [The Ring Fauvist Student](persona:0515)'s enhanced S3.

guide:3:0:1.text: Fill remaining slots with Bleed Identities. [Night Awls Capitano](persona:1213) and [Hornet【Alteration】](persona:0514) are excellent at accumulating negative effects.

guide:3:0:2.text: [The Priest of La Manchaland](persona:1210) fuels Bloodfeast in the Bloodfiend variant. Often, guarding to focus on enabling Whistles is better than trying to deal damage with his skills.

guide:3:0:3.text: [Haute Couture:: The Crimson God of Le Rouge](persona:1016) Sinclair and [Haute Couture:: Boutique du Rouge](persona:0816) Ishmael also make a strong pair. The Crimson God's S2 and S3 hurt allies, but Le Rouge Identities take priority for those hits and endure through self-healing. More Le Rouge Identities make the package stronger.

guide:3:0:4.text: Healing mainly comes from these two.

guide:3:0:7.text: The Bloodfiend variant can aim for a large burst through Don Quixote's [Yearning-Mircalla](ego:0307).

guide:4:0:0.text: The Ring variant has a largely fixed lineup. Without all 5, the Corporist members have a weak opening.

guide:4:0:1.text: Fluid Sac is hard to fund in Regular Encounters starting with zero resources.

metadata.description: Limbus Company Bleed team guide: Identities that apply and maintain Bleed. Covers the Ring variant with 5 Ring members and the Bloodfiend variant that cycles Bloodfeast with La Manchaland Identities, with priority, flexible, and bench roles.

note: English translation of the existing public team guide and lineup notes; preserves the Japanese recommendations.
